title: Playing the 101 Ranch and its personnel
summary: Ridgley recalls the rough 101 Ranch, with one and a half dollars a night plus tips, and names the band: John Vigne on piano, Louis Cottrell on drums, clarinet players.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: We played there for Mr. I think Mr. Albert, what was his name now? We played 101 Ranch a long time. We used to start playing at eight. Playing until wee in the morning when he'd break up. We only got a dollar and a half a night for playing there but we made the tips was good, you see. Oh yeah. That was a rough place but we made good tips in there.
Who was in the band at that time?
John Veen was playing piano. Louis. John Veen?
John Veen. The drummer played piano too?

Oh, I see. That was his son. He did too. John Veen playing piano. Celeste on the clarinet. Theo on clarinet. Louis Cantrell on drums. And myself on drumming on. Did you name a bass player? Billy has no bass player. And no banjo? Guitar? Did you name somebody I can't remember? How busy is going to sleep. Look like it ain't. If you getting tired we'll turn this thing off.
